mainEntity.name: How do you ensure youth athletes train safely and prevent injuries?

acceptedAnswer.text: Safety is paramount in youth athlete training, especially given their developing bodies. At Cave Training, we prioritize proper form and technique over heavy lifting or excessive intensity. Our coaches are experienced in youth physiology and implement progressive overload principles, gradually increasing demands as the athlete gains strength and skill. We also focus on mobility, flexibility, and core stability to build a resilient body. Regular communication with parents and athletes about any discomfort or fatigue is encouraged to adjust training as needed and minimize injury risk.
acceptedAnswer.description: We ensure safety by prioritizing proper form, progressive overload, and focusing on mobility and core stability. Our coaches adjust training based on individual needs and communicate with athletes and parents.
